sn11.19:0.3: The Worship of the Teacher (or Sakka’s Worship (2))
sn11.19:1.7: “Then, bhikkhus, Sakka, lord of the devas, descending from the Vejayanta Palace, raised his joined hands in reverential salutation and worshipped the Blessed One.
sn11.19:1.8: Then Matali the charioteer addressed Sakka, lord of the devas, in verse:
sn11.19:2.3: So who, O Sakka, is that spirit
sn11.19:2.4: To whom you bow in worship?’
sn11.19:3.1:
Sakka:
“‘The Perfectly Enlightened One here
In this world with its devas,
sn11.19:3.4: He is the one whom I worship, Matali.
sn11.19:4.1:
“‘Those for whom lust and hatred
And ignorance have been expunged,
sn11.19:4.4: These are the ones whom I worship, Matali.
sn11.19:5.3: For the removal of lust and hatred,
sn11.19:5.5: These are the ones whom I worship, Matali.’
sn11.19:6.2:
my lord Sakka,
Are indeed the best in the world.
sn11.19:7.1:
The Blessed One:
“Having given this explanation,
Having worshipped the Blessed One,
